environment.description: Docusign environment. When omitted from an E-Signature request, defaults to docusignEnvironment in the site configuration.
environment.title: DocusignEnvironment

returnUrl.description: Identifies the return point after sending the envelope

recipientId.description: A reference used to map recipients to other objects, such as specific document tabs.

userName.description: The username of the recipient. You can use either email and userName.

email.description: Specifies the email of the recipient

frameAncestors.description: An array of ancestors that can embed the frame. Include the domain where the envelope will be embedded and the same URL as messageOrigins.

messageOrigins.description: The originating domain for the signature request message
